title: Run and Interrogate Your First ML System
core_invariant: Start with the useful whole. Predict before running. Transfer without assistance. Prove competence with evidence.

stages.title: Frame the whole supervised system
stages.instructions: Read the mission invariant and the Wine vertical slice: local CSV, 13 measurements, 3-class target, stratified split, fit on training rows only, predict on held-out features, honest metrics, then interrogation. Identify the evidence the gate will require. This is a generic composition of catalogue stages, not a custom M02 runtime.

stages.title: Map raw data through interrogation
stages.instructions: Annotate the data-flow map: raw CSV -> features and target -> stratified train/test split -> preprocessing plus classifier fit on training rows only -> predictions for held-out rows -> accuracy, balanced accuracy, confusion -> error and experiment interrogation. Mark where test labels are forbidden.

stages.title: Interrogate fit, predict, and evaluation boundaries
stages.instructions: Probe the information-flow invariants. Does predict require y_test? Must preprocessing statistics come from training rows only? What would a perfect 1.0 score mean if predictions are compared to themselves?

stages.title: Locate fit, predict, and metric calls
stages.instructions: Trace the exact learning boundaries: the first line where model state can change (fit), the line where fitted state is consumed without new labels (predict), and the line where truth is allowed to re-enter (evaluation). Explain why comparing predictions to predictions is executable but invalid evidence.

stages.title: Predict, execute, and submit one controlled change
stages.instructions: Complete the experiment cycle on the local Wine-style supervised system. Change one dimension at a time (split, features, model, selected hyperparameter, labels, or evaluation setup). (1) PREDICT how the honest held-out score will move and why. (2) COMMIT the prediction so it cannot be edited. (3) EXECUTE / RUN the controlled comparison. (4) OBSERVE metrics, class counts, and diagnostics. (5) SUBMIT an explanation of any delta between prediction and observation, naming constants you preserved.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Prediction is sealed before execute; the submitted explanation covers the single changed dimension, preserved constants, and honest held-out metrics.

stages.title: Diagnose corrupted labels and invalid evaluation
stages.instructions: Run two seeded epistemic failures. Failure A permutes training labels while preserving class counts: diagnose with disagreement rate and honest held-out metrics, then restore row-label alignment. Failure B scores accuracy_score(predictions, predictions) and returns 1.0: name the wrong boundary, repair by comparing y_test with aligned predictions, and verify against the honest baseline. Record hypothesis, evidence, root cause, smallest repair, and a monitoring check.

stages.title: Fresh supervised run without assistance
stages.instructions: In a blank run, rebuild a supervised classifier from local Wine-style rows. Choose a split seed, feature set, model, and at least one hyperparameter so the recipe differs from the guided baseline in at least two dimensions. Tutor, hints, and prior-answer surfaces stay locked. Submit a runnable raw-data through interrogation artifact, a prediction written before execution, disjoint-row validation, metrics plus confusion, boundary identification, one controlled failure with repair, and a five-sentence limitations explanation.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Fresh no-AI supervised run with sealed reasoning, honest evaluation, and an independent explanation of what the model learned from, never saw, and cannot claim.

stages.title: Connect the vertical slice to V00
stages.instructions: Explain how this interrogable supervised slice supplies V00's first executable whole: a shared vocabulary of features, target, split, fit, prediction, evaluation, and interrogation, plus the guardrail that executable code and impressive metrics are not automatically valid evidence.

stages.title: Evaluate gate evidence
stages.instructions: Evaluate submitted orientation, experiment, controlled-failure, and transfer evidence against the mission gate contract. Issue PASSED or a targeted repair plan for unmet knowledge nodes. Do not award completion from a copied baseline or a score alone.
